title: 已经 (yǐjīng) "Already" in Chinese: HSK 2 Grammar with Examples
description: How to say "already" in Chinese with 已经……了 (yǐjīng... le): word order, ages and times, "not yet" with 还没有, questions, and HSK 2 examples.
h1: How to Say "Already" with 已经……了
lede: 已经 (yǐjīng) means "already". It almost always comes with 了 at the end of the sentence: 已经 + verb + 了. Together they say that something has happened, or that a situation has been reached, by now. It is a key grammar point of HSK 2.

paras: 已经 is an adverb, so it goes after the subject and straight before the verb. The 了 at the end shows that the action has happened. You could also just say 我吃饭了, but 已经 adds the idea that it is done by now, often sooner than the other person thinks.
已经……了 also works with adjectives, clock times, ages and lengths of time. It says a point has been reached. With a time or a number and no subject, the sentence can begin with 已经.
With a length of time, as in 两年, you can use 了 after the verb as well as at the end: the action began in the past and is still going on.

examples.zh: 已经十点了，我们回家吧。
examples.py: Yǐjīng shí diǎn le, wǒmen huí jiā ba.
examples.en: It's already ten o'clock, let's go home.

examples.py: Wǒ érzi yǐjīng liù suì le.

examples.zh: 我已经学了两年中文了。
examples.py: Wǒ yǐjīng xué le liǎng nián Zhōngwén le.
examples.en: I've been learning Chinese for two years now.

sections.h2: Common mistakes: word order and the missing 了
paras: In English, "already" can go at the end of the sentence. In Chinese, 已经 never does: say 我们已经到了, not 我们到了已经. It also does not go in front of the subject, so 已经他回家了 is wrong.
The other common mistake is to forget 了. 我已经吃饭 sounds unfinished to a Chinese speaker. Keep 了 at the end of the sentence.

sections.h2: Not yet, no longer, and questions
paras: The opposite of 已经……了 is 还没有 + verb, "not yet". Do not use 已经 for this, and drop 了: 我还没有吃饭, not 我已经没有吃饭了. With 不, 已经不……了 means "no longer" or "not any more".
To ask whether something has already happened, add 吗 to the end. Answer yes with 已经 + verb + 了, or no with 还没有.

examples.py: Nǐ yǐjīng mǎi piào le ma?
examples.en: Have you already bought the tickets?

examples.py: Wǒ yǐjīng bù hē kāfēi le.
examples.en: I don't drink coffee any more.

worksheet.title: 已经……了 Worksheet: HSK 2 Printable with Answers
worksheet.description: A free printable 已经……了 (already) worksheet for HSK 2: 20 exercises (已经 or 还没有, word order, fix the mistake) with an answer key.

exercises.h2: Choose 已经 or 还没有
exercises.instructions: Write 已经 or 还没有 in each gap. The English tells you what the sentence means.

items.en: I've already eaten, you go ahead.
He hasn't got up yet, he's still asleep.
The film has already started, come in quickly.

items.zh: 妈妈＿＿回来，我们等等她吧。
items.en: Mum isn't back yet, let's wait for her.
It's already twelve o'clock, go to bed.
I haven't finished reading this book yet.
He's already home.
I haven't bought the train ticket yet; I'll buy it tomorrow.
Dinner's ready already, come and eat.

exercises.instructions: Write the words as one correct sentence.

items.en: He has already left.
It's already nine o'clock.
We've already arrived at the airport.
My little sister is already twenty.
He hasn't come home yet.
He doesn't work here any more.
answers: 他已经不在这儿工作了。

exercises.instructions: Each sentence has one mistake. Write the correct sentence.

items.en: He has already got up.
She has already finished work.
We've already arrived.
He hasn't come yet.
He hasn't gone to bed yet.
